subtopics.title: When to Finetune
subtopics.summary: Criteria for deciding whether to finetune versus using prompt-based methods, considering resource requirements in data, hardware, and ML talent.

subtopics.title: Full Finetuning
subtopics.summary: The approach of training all model parameters, where the number of trainable parameters equals the total number of parameters, typically used when models are small enough.

subtopics.title: Adapter-Based Finetuning
subtopics.summary: Parameter-efficient finetuning techniques that allow adapting models with less memory, often requiring only a mid-tier GPU, supported by frameworks like PEFT and LLaMA-Factory.

subtopics.title: Finetuning Frameworks and Compute
subtopics.summary: Overview of finetuning frameworks such as LLaMA-Factory, unsloth, Axolotl, and LitGPT, and compute provisioning options ranging from local GPUs to cloud integration.

subtopics.title: Data and Memory Considerations
subtopics.summary: Challenges of obtaining finetuning data and calculating model memory footprint, including memory bottlenecks that make native finetuning memory-intensive.
